sections.h2: Color with the building in mind
body: A good color plan starts with the architecture. The wood-framed Cracker homes in Historic Downtown were built simply, with porches, board siding, and visible trim, and they usually look their best in schemes that let those details read: a body color, a contrasting trim, and perhaps a porch ceiling or door accent. Stucco homes in Rainbow Lake Estates and Rolling Hills have fewer trim lines, so the body color does more of the work. Color consultation in Dunnellon, FL takes those differences into account before a single chip is pulled. It draws on what our Dunnellon painters see on homes across town.

bullets: Walk the property and note fixed elements: roof, masonry, flooring, counters
Talk through the look you want and any neighborhood or HOA color rules
Narrow to a short list and roll out full-size drawdowns on site
Check them in morning and late-afternoon light
Record final colors, sheens, and products on your written estimate

body: Owners of older homes often want colors that feel right for the period without looking like a museum. The historic color ideas from Gainesville include examples that translate well to Dunnellon's older houses. Practical points matter as much as history: deep colors on south and west walls fade sooner, and porches with dark floors get hot underfoot.

Homes under heavy shade near Rainbow Springs get cooler, greener light, which can make grays look flat and whites look dingy. Rooms with big west windows get warm, intense light in the afternoon. We test colors where they will live, and we factor in sheen, since a satin bath and a matte bedroom in the same color will not look identical. Our article on Florida interior paint colors offers a starting palette, and the choices feed straight into interior painting in Dunnellon.

Shops and offices downtown have a different goal: a facade that is easy to spot and fits the character of the street. We help owners choose body and trim colors that work with signage and awnings, and that will not look chalky after a few summers. Deep accent colors are best kept to doors and trim, where a future touch-up is simple.

No label on the old can? Bring a flake of the old paint, a removable piece of trim, or whatever is left in the garage; we will match it and paint a sample panel so you can compare side by side. See the main color consultation service for more.

faqs.q: Do you help with exterior colors for historic homes?
faqs.a: Yes. We look at the architecture, roof, and setting and test options at full size so you can see them on the house.
A large painted sample of the actual paint and sheen, big enough to judge in real light instead of relying on a small chip.

faqs.q: Can a color consultation be part of a painting estimate?
faqs.a: Yes. The selected colors, sheens, and products are written into the estimate so everything is agreed before work starts.
